Name: Wormhole NoC
Description: Tile-oriented SoC design, where components located at different tiles exchange messages in a unified manner. IPs interface to the NoC by means of a Network Interface (NI) which complies with AXI protocol. The NoC router supports 2D mesh topologies.
Comment: ISOLDE WI ID 2.2.02; IP card lives in the source repository (doc/ip_cards/UPV_NOC.jsonc).
